admissible: Each edit in A exactly two serialize entries and one direct fallback site, B exactly one entry and zero fallback. Unchanged commands in both zero for both sites. All 64 use the same target signature. Never prune samples after observing IR.
counts: 64 Cargo invocations: each direction 8 A/B transitions, each immediately paired within logical arm history with the same-state repeat; independently balanced four AB + four BA orders per endpoint. Finite no replacement cohort; retain every raw command on failure.
fallback: If credible headers/runtime, thread calibrations, original true owner, PID/exec coverage or raw products cannot be established, no counts. No substituting another tool after samples.
hardware_gate: Repeat direct ordinary hardware perf_event_open first. Software counter permitted only after denial. Recalibrate each prior source-bound 64-bit client on both low and high pthread/one-child/eight-child workloads on H8. Require all same-owner start/end and known deltas. No host configuration changes.
host: H8 only, 24GiB minimum on both ext4 volumes, 16GiB tmpfs, no other timed jobs. Keep prior donor and physical records intact.
native_calibration: Calibrate each independently built counter on normal 2,000,000-increment x86 sub/jne loop owned by a second pthread (4,000,000 +/-40,000 count delta). Independently compare one and eight child fork/exec processes at the same two work settings (absolute parent delta below 100,000), with matched per-thread start/exit and no child loop site. Require off-clock matched native reverse/restore/unchanged and unchanged subsequent intervals, both verifiable complete product hashes and real caller.
scope: Count all genuine native parent instructions on exactly the two distinct images. Independent pre/post exec tracing requires zero compiler, linker, build script, matching rosters and runtime. Enforce physical measured complete outputs through each logical pathname and saved marker: edited states change marker; repeated states are fresh and retain it. Check per-process separate thread init/exit totals, real argv and Cargo file hash, physical exit code, empty stdout, healthy cargo stderr and stable parent root. Require a counter-process child/execution audit, in addition to genuine unprofiled controls. Use a syscall observer/audited fork policy or pre/post matched executable census if ptrace/DBI conflict; identify exact measurement coverage and refuse any unaccounted exec.

Validate both hashes, full typed roster and runtime before and after; no cold rebuild or recreation of common target allowed.

Hardware retired counts unavailable.
